title: TensorPlate Supervision Event
description: Discrete agent-owned worker-supervision event (V01-E09-F05). Emitted by `tensorplate-agent` at every supervision state transition and consumed by the V01-E10 observability service plus V01-E11 status/log views. Events carry monotonic timing, bounded context, and per-process sequence numbers; the sink is non-blocking and may drop events when its bounded queue is full.

kind.description: Discrete supervision event kind. The set is union-stable: post-v0.1.0 additions append rather than rename.

sequence.description: Per-agent-process monotonically increasing sequence number. The supervisor never reuses a sequence within one process lifetime; consumers order events by `sequence` and detect drops by gaps.

monotonic_timestamp_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds. Sampled from `std::time::Instant`. NEVER wall-clock.

serving_state.description: Stable supervision-state name shared with V01-E10 and V01-E11. Matches `SupervisionPhase` in `tensorplate_agent::supervision`.

active_deployment.description: Desired active deployment id; empty when no deployment is configured.

backend.description: Backend hint published by the bundle this worker is serving.

restart_count.description: Rolling count of unexpected exits + not-ready failures inside the configured window.

next_restart_delay_ms.description: Computed backoff delay for the next launch attempt, populated on `restart_scheduled`.

exit_code.description: Worker process exit code, when known.

after_ready.description: True when the worker reached the ready state before this exit.

error_code.description: Typed error code accompanying `worker_not_ready`, `worker_failed`, and `worker_exit` events.

message.description: Optional bounded diagnostic context. Implementations truncate to <= 512 bytes.
